using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;
typedef pair<int, int> pii;
typedef pair<ll, ll> pll;
typedef double ld;

ll binPow(ll a, int b, int p) {
    if (b == 0)
        return 1;
    ll x = binPow(a, b / 2, p);
    x *= x;
    x %= p;
    if (b & 1) {
        x *= a;
        x %= p;
    }
    return x;
}

int n, k, p;
const int MAXN = 250250;
ll fact[MAXN], rfact[MAXN];
ll g[MAXN][17];

void solve(int n, const vector<int> &bit, int k, int l) {
    if (k == (int)bit.size()) {
        for (int i = 1; i < 17; ++i) {
            g[n][i] += rfact[l] * g[n ^ l][i - 1];
            g[n][i] %= p;
        }
        return;
    }
    solve(n, bit, k + 1, l);
    solve(n, bit, k + 1, l ^ (1 << bit[k]));
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);
    cout.tie(0);

    cin >> n >> k >> p;
    if (n & 1) {
        cout << binPow(k, n, p) << "\n";
        return 0;
    }

    fact[0] = 1;
    rfact[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        fact[i] = fact[i - 1] * i % p;
        rfact[i] = binPow(fact[i], p - 2, p);
    }

    g[0][0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        if ((i & n) != i)
            continue;
        vector<int> bit;
        for (int j = 0; j < 18; ++j) {
            if ((1 << j) & i)
                bit.push_back(j);
        }
        if (!bit.empty()) {
            solve(i, bit, 1, 1 << bit[0]);
        }
        for (int j = 0; j < 17; ++j)
            g[i][j] %= p;
    }
    ll ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= min(16, k); ++i) {
        g[n][i] %= p;
        ll cur = fact[n] * g[n][i];
        cur %= p;
        cur *= fact[k];
        cur %= p;
        cur *= rfact[k - i];
        cur %= p;
        ans += cur;
        ans %= p;
    }
    ans = binPow(k, n, p) - ans;
    if (ans < 0)
        ans += p;
    cout << ans << "\n";
    return 0;
}

    ll result = 1;
    base %= mod;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) 
            result = (result * base) % mod;
        base = (base * base) % mod;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);

        return 0;
    }

    vector<ll> fact(n + 1), rfact(n + 1);
    fact[0] = 1;
    rfact[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        fact[i] = fact[i-1] * i % p;
        rfact[i] = mod_pow(fact[i], p-2, p);
    }

    vector<vector<ll>> g(n + 1, vector<ll>(17, 0));
    g[0][0] = 1;

    for (int mask = 1; mask <= n; ++mask) {
        if ((mask & n) != mask) continue;
        
        vector<int> bits;
        for (int j = 0; j < 18; ++j) {
            if (mask & (1 << j))

            }

    for (int i = 0; i <= n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < 17; ++j) {
            g[i][j] %= p;
            if (g[i][j] < 0) g[i][j] += p;
        }
    }

    ll ans = 0;
    int upper = min(16, k);
    for (int i = 1; i <= upper; ++i) {
        ll term = fact[n] * g[n][i] % p;
        term = term * fact[k] % p;
        term = term * rfact[k - i] % p;

    ans = (mod_pow(k, n, p) - ans + p) % p;
    cout << ans << '\n';
